basis: Uncharacterized; meristem RNA in situ in P. simonii root tip (no sense control, low resolution) and top cluster-9 DE gene (log2FC 4.68, pct 0.94 vs 0.14; Table S9). Cluster 9 homologs are RPS27A/HSP genes, so this may mark a proliferative state rather than a lineage (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).

F-box SKP2B homolog (At AT1G77000, a lateral-root founder/meristem gene); meristem RNA in situ and RNAi/OE alter LR number in P. simonii, but highest-in-meristem only by boxplot, not a top DE gene (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).

Uncharacterized; RNA in situ in outer layer (broad, no control) and DE in clusters 4/0 (log2FC 2.49, pct 0.83 vs 0.19). Published as Atrichoblast, but that label is unsupported (no GL2/WER; 32% of cells), so used here as pan-epidermis (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).
Extensin/AGP31-like (Table S10 BLAST to AT1G28290, e=8e-42); top DE gene of cluster 7 (log2FC 3.48, pct 0.59 vs 0.10). Expression only (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).
Ole e 1-like protein; Table S10 BLAST hit AT5G10130 (listed as an Arabidopsis columella marker, e=2e-47); cluster 7 DE (log2FC 2.39, pct 0.32 vs 0.03) (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).
LEA-like; Table S10 BLAST hits AT5G54370/AT5G60530 (Arabidopsis root-cap markers, e<1e-75); cluster 7 DE (log2FC 3.58, pct 0.33 vs 0.08) (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).

STIG1/GRI-like small Cys-rich protein (Table S10 BLAST AT1G50720/AT5G55110/AT4G26880, Arabidopsis cap markers); DE in LRC cluster 3 (log2FC 2.25, pct 0.92 vs 0.33) and columella cluster 7, so pan-cap (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).
Beta-galactosidase (Table S10 BLAST BGAL4 AT5G56870, e=0); weak cluster-2 DE (log2FC 1.35, pct 0.59 vs 0.38). Use only with other cortex evidence (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).

Cinnamoyl-CoA reductase-like (Table S10 BLAST CCR2 AT1G80820, e=6e-50); cluster 10 DE (log2FC 2.45, pct 0.84 vs 0.11). Phenylpropanoid gene: cluster 10 may be a suberizing endodermis or exodermis, check CASP/MYB36 homologs (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).

3-ketoacyl-CoA synthase-like (weak Table S10 BLAST KCS1 AT1G01120, e=4e-8); cluster 10 DE (log2FC 2.93, pct 0.89 vs 0.14). VLCFA/suberin-type; same suberizing-layer caveat (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).

Uncharacterized; cluster 10 DE (log2FC 3.24, pct 0.97 vs 0.25). CONFLICT: its Table S10 homolog AT5G66230 is listed as a dividing-cell/proximal-meristem/root-cap marker, not endodermis (Li et al. 2025 Plant Physiol).

WOX4-like homeobox; PttWOX4a/b expressed in the cambial zone and RNAi reduces cambial width and secondary growth in Populus (Kucukoglu et al. 2017 New Phytol); DE in the cambium+phloem spatial domain of 84K cutting bases (Table S3 stage 2 c3, log2FC 1.18, pct 0.26 vs 0.10; Lv et al. 2024 Hortic Res). Not the same gene as PsiWOX4 (Psi02G012270; likely the chr2 paralog).

Ribosomal protein uL4/RPL4 (UniProt B9IIY9; paper calls it SUPPRESSOR OF ACTIN 56, which is wrong); RNA in situ in adventitious-root primordia (Lv et al. 2024 Hortic Res). Housekeeping translation gene, a proliferation proxy; near-ubiquitous in Table S3 (pct 0.91 vs 0.54).

Translation elongation factor 2 (UniProt B9HH10); RNA in situ in adventitious-root primordia (Lv et al. 2024 Hortic Res). Housekeeping, a proliferation proxy; near-ubiquitous in Table S3 (pct 0.93 vs 0.69).
WOX13-clade homeobox; RNA in situ in AR primordia (Fig. S6, not inspected in detail; Lv et al. 2024 Hortic Res). Table S5 gives the Potri ID of LOS1 for it (Potri.007G065700), so no valid Potri ID.
